crossRefs.note: Behold, the former things have happened and I declare new things. I tell you about them before they come up.”
“For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders…
You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,
Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. Yahweh is gracious and merciful.
“Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that they will no more say, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up the…
but, ‘As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the offspring of the house of Israel out of the north country, and…
We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers…
I am Yahweh, and there is no one else. Besides me, there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not known me,
that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is no one besides me. I am Yahweh, and…
Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to…
For Yahweh who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a…
Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it…
“Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
“To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?
“There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
